feat.name: Ueno Toshogu Peony Garden
feat.desc: A specialized peony garden within Ueno Park, featuring 40 varieties of winter peonies protected by traditional straw mats (yukitsuri).

feat.name: Kairakuen Garden
feat.desc: Considered one of the three great gardens of Japan, famous for over 3,000 plum trees of 100 different varieties.

feat.name: Kenrokuen (Ishikawa)
feat.desc: One of the Three Great Gardens of Japan, beautiful in all seasons.

feat.name: Shinjuku Gyoen (Tokyo)
feat.desc: A major park in Tokyo with spacious lawns and cherry blossoms.

feat.name: Funaoka Castle Ruin Park (Miyagi)
feat.desc: Known for the view of the cherry blossoms against the backdrop of Mount Zao.

feat.name: Tonami Tulip Park (Toyama)
feat.jp: となみチューリップ公園
feat.desc: Famous for its massive Tulip Fair showcasing millions of tulips.

feat.name: Yuushien Garden
feat.desc: A stunning garden on Daikonshima Island famous for peonies (Botan). The pond filled with 30,000 floating peonies is a masterpiece.

feat.name: Chausuyama Highlands
feat.desc: A ski resort that turns into a pink carpet of 400,000 Shibazakura (Moss Phlox) plants in spring, the highest in Aichi Prefecture.

feat.name: Higashizawa Rose Park (Yamagata)
feat.desc: One of the largest rose gardens in Japan, hosting a Rose Festival in June.

feat.name: Oishi Park
feat.desc: Lavender fields with the iconic Mount Fuji in the background. A breathtaking summer view.

feat.name: Shinobazu Pond (Ueno)
feat.desc: Shinobazu Pond is almost completely covered by lush green lotus leaves and large pink flowers in summer, creating a spiritual atmosphere.

feat.name: Okayama Korakuen
feat.desc: Another of Japan's Three Great Gardens. In summer, the garden hosts 'Fantasy Garden' illuminations and blooming lotuses.

feat.name: Yakachi River
feat.desc: The Yakachi River is lined with 3 million red spider lilies stretching for 1.5km, creating a fairy-tale-like red ribbon along the riverbank.

feat.name: Showa Kinen Park
feat.desc: A massive park known for its vast fields of cosmos flowers in autumn, painting the hills in shades of pink, white, and purple.

feat.name: Engakuji Temple
feat.desc: A serene Zen temple famous for its vibrant autumn foliage and late-blooming flowers in the fall.

feat.name: Nabana no Sato
feat.desc: Famous for its winter illumination and a massive indoor Begonia Garden that blooms year-round, perfect for winter visits.
